title: Three Well-Dressed Men in Garden, 1940s Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: Three gentlemen pose together on a sunny lawn in front of a Spanish-style residence with clay roof tiles, brick border details, and lush garden foliage. Flanking a taller companion wearing a light collared shirt and high-waisted pleated trousers, the two men wear classic 1940s-tailored suits with wide lapels and patterned neckties, with one holding a fedora hat. The image reflects post-World War II mid-century menswear and social life.
